FIT fixtures are generated by the Garmin Connect IQ simulator from Resiliento's scripted test workouts. They contain no athlete activity or real route. Their all-zero sideload application ID is intentional. The test suite also checks production identity mapping and rejection of unrelated developer identities.

- `resiliento-all-stations.fit`: 21 laps, nine station types and all five phases, dynamic SESSION fields.
- `resiliento-quick.fit`: Run / SkiErg / Run, PM5 test measurements.
- `resiliento-legacy-zero.fit`: older SESSION layout with an explicitly entered zero Wall Ball result.
